title: Meridian document
description: A Meridian document: an Infrastructure or a ResourceSet. Generated by `meridian schema`; do not edit.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document language this document is written in.

oneOf.description: The first version of the Meridian document language.

kind.description: What the document describes: `Infrastructure` provisions things, `ResourceSet` configures something that exists.

oneOf.description: Provisions things that later documents are applied to: machines, networks, clusters. Compiles for an infrastructure-as-code target and may declare outputs.
Describes the desired state of something that already exists: the packages, files and services on a host, or the workloads on a cluster.

name.description: The document's name. It must be unique among documents of the same kind in a workflow, and it is what `targetHost.ref` refers to.

labels.description: Names and values used to select documents with `-l/--selector`, as in `tier=web,env!=prod`. Labels are not passed to the target.

SecretSource.description: Another place a secret is looked for, when the places before it have nothing.

from.description: The provider the value is fetched from.

oneOf.description: The output of a program, given by `command`. No shell reads it.
A key in the Linux kernel keyring, found by its description, `key`.
A credential systemd passed to this unit, named by `key`.
An item in the freedesktop Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet), found by its `attributes`.
A generic password in the macOS keychain, found by `service` and `account`.

key.description: With `from: env`: the environment variable that holds the value. With `from: keyring`: the description of the key. With `from: systemd-creds`: the name of the credential.

path.description: With `from: file`: the file that holds the value.

command.description: With `from: exec`: the program and its arguments, as a list. No shell reads them.

service.description: With `from: keychain`: the service of the keychain item.

account.description: With `from: keychain`: the account of the keychain item.

attributes.description: With `from: secret-service`: the attributes the item is found by. They are not secret.

allowWideMode.description: With `from: file`: read the file even though others can read it as well.

keepTrailingNewline.description: With `from: file` and `from: systemd-creds`: keep the value's last line ending.

Secret.description: A secret's name and where it comes from. Its value is never written in a document.

name.description: The name the secret is read by, as `secret.<name>`.

from.description: The provider the value is fetched from.

oneOf.description: The output of a program, given by `command`. No shell reads it.
A key in the Linux kernel keyring, found by its description, `key`.
A credential systemd passed to this unit, named by `key`.
An item in the freedesktop Secret Service (GNOME Keyring, KWallet), found by its `attributes`.
A generic password in the macOS keychain, found by `service` and `account`.

key.description: With `from: env`: the environment variable that holds the value. With `from: keyring`: the description of the key. With `from: systemd-creds`: the name of the credential.

path.description: With `from: file`: the file that holds the value.

command.description: With `from: exec`: the program and its arguments, as a list. No shell reads them.

service.description: With `from: keychain`: the service of the keychain item.

account.description: With `from: keychain`: the account of the keychain item.

attributes.description: With `from: secret-service`: the attributes the item is found by. They are not secret.

allowWideMode.description: With `from: file`: read the file even though others can read it as well.

keepTrailingNewline.description: With `from: file` and `from: systemd-creds`: keep the value's last line ending.

optional.description: A secret that cannot be found is `null` instead of an error.

fallback.description: The places to look next, in order, when the first has nothing or cannot be used on this machine.

Import.description: A value the document's tool is handed from another document of the workflow.

name.description: The name the value arrives under, as the tool's own variable or parameter.

oneOf.description: The text of a file another document compiles to, named by `ref` and `file`.
A value another document's apply produced, named by `ref` and `output`.

ref.description: The `metadata.name` of the document the value comes from.

file.description: With `from: artifact`: the compiled file whose text is the value.

output.description: With `from: output`: the output whose value it is.

sensitive.description: Mask the value wherever Meridian prints.

Dependency.description: A hard ordering constraint: the named resource is applied before this one.

resource.description: The id of the resource that must be applied first.

ifMissing.description: What to do when a `when` condition has removed the named resource.

oneOf.description: Refuse to compile when the named resource is not in the compiled document. This is the default.
Drop this edge when a `when` condition has removed the named resource.

when.description: A condition on this dependency alone. When it is false the entry is dropped and both resources stay.

Notification.description: A trigger: when this resource changes, the named resource performs an action.

resource.description: The id of the resource to notify.

on.description: The event that fires the notify.

oneOf.description: Fire when the notifying resource really changed. This is also what leaving `on` out means.

action.description: What the notified resource does, such as `restart` or `reload`. Which actions exist depends on the target and the notified resource's type.

ifMissing.description: What to do when a `when` condition has removed the named resource.

oneOf.description: Refuse to compile when the named resource is not in the compiled document. This is the default.
Drop this edge when a `when` condition has removed the named resource.

when.description: A condition on this notify alone. When it is false the entry is dropped and both resources stay.

id.description: The resource's name within the document. `dependsOn`, `notifies` and `${id.param}` references use it, so it must be unique.

type.description: What kind of thing the resource is. The target decides which types exist.

state.description: The state the resource should be left in, such as `present` or `running`. Each type has a default, used when this is left out.

when.description: A condition Meridian decides while compiling, from the values given with `--data`. When it is false the resource is left out of the compiled document. Example: `data.env == "prod" && defined(data.region)`.

runtimeWhen.description: A condition written in the tool's own language and checked on the node at the moment of apply. Only a target that can express it accepts it.

params.description: The resource's settings. The target and the resource type decide which params exist.

dependsOn.description: Resources that must be applied before this one.

notifies.description: Resources to trigger when this one changes.

Output.description: A value this document hands to later documents in the workflow.

name.description: The name later documents ask for the value by.

value.description: Where the value comes from, usually a reference to something the tool reports after applying, such as `${web_vm.public_ip}`.

when.description: A condition on the output. When it is false the output is not declared.

InfrastructureSpec.description: What an Infrastructure document provisions, and what it hands on.

target.description: The target plugin that compiles this document and runs its tool, such as `ansible` or `terraform`.

targetVersion.description: The version of the target's tool to compile for. Only a target that declares versions accepts it.

when.description: A condition on the whole document. When it is false the document is skipped.

variables.description: Named values, worked out once per document and read as `var.<name>`.

conditions.description: Named conditions, read as `cond.<name>` by any `when` in the document.

secrets.description: The secrets the document reads, each a name and where it comes from, read as `secret.<name>`.

imports.description: Values handed to the document's tool from other documents of the workflow.

resources.description: The resources that make up the document. At least one is required.

outputs.description: Values this document hands to later documents, such as a new machine's address.
